diagnostic.subject: Primary body surfaces
diagnostic.finding: Body uses sparse longitudinal sections and planar bands. Hood is one base quad, doors three base quads each. Missing compound curvature, sculpted fender shoulders and coherent transitions.
diagnostic.decision: Rebuild surfaces from calibrated master sections and consistent orthographic views

diagnostic.subject: Reference target and proportions
diagnostic.finding: Toy editions differ. Current dimensions are estimates; two real-car photos cannot establish exact wheelbase, taper and overhang errors.
diagnostic.decision: Select cartoon design and matching Camaro/trim evidence; calibrate wheel centers, width, roof height and overhangs before detail

diagnostic.subject: Door/cabin fit
diagnostic.finding: Correct roof-to-side bend concept, but flat wall-like surfaces, rod-like pillars and broad black assembly gaps. Window overlays are not developed frame/aperture assemblies.
diagnostic.decision: Retain hierarchy as proxy; rebuild skins, outer pillars, window frames, returns and hinge attachments; no cockpit

diagnostic.subject: Front and rear assemblies
diagnostic.finding: Front is too vertical and block-like, lamp recesses shallow/simplistic, lower intakes protrude as black blocks. Tail lamps are thin strips and rear fascia is an assembled slab. Reactor rings are recognizable outlines but not developed nozzle volumes.
diagnostic.decision: Rebuild assemblies and reassess travel clearances after body redesign

diagnostic.subject: Topology
diagnostic.finding: Body is closed and has no measured zero-area faces, but boolean-generated planar n-gons are not a controlled car-surface cage. Small-part bevels create degenerate evaluated faces.
diagnostic.decision: Controlled quad patches for curved surfaces, stable n-gons only where planar; inspect bevel limits and triangulation. Avoid indiscriminate global subdivision/remesh

diagnostic.subject: Secondary geometry
diagnostic.finding: Wheel holes are black disk overlays; guns, mirrors, spoiler support and trim remain simplified primitives.
diagnostic.decision: Retain semantic names and attachment roles, rebuild/refine visible meshes after primary shape acceptance
